cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.instruction: Use every problem as justification for adding another rule, ceremony, checkpoint, or layer of oversight.

mechanism: Copy a photographer's closed eye as a posing method, then impose a verification ritual to cure the photo problem.
confusable: Not knowingly inventing an absurd ceremony: B2 reveals the copied eye position was for a viewfinder, not a pose.
comparison: Family photo coordination differs from the tea scene's physical cleanup.
seedUse: Retains the failed family photo and blink-control impulse from Drive; changes rehearsal monitors into a verbal eyes-check ceremony.
